title: Layer 1: Hormuz Direct Indicators
title_zh: 第一层：霍尔木兹直射指标
desc: Core variables driving the entire chain
desc_zh: 所有逻辑链的第一推动力

warRiskPremium.note: PREMIUM EASING: From active combat (Jun 26-28) to diplomatic track. US-Iran Doha talks (Jul 2-3) produced agreement to continue discussions. Joint statement on Strait of Hormuz (Jul 3). Oman proposes fee plan for gradual re-opening (NYT, Jul 3). UN warns gradual re-opening is 'no quick fix' (Jul 1). Khamenei funeral (Jul 4-6) putting talks on hold. War risk premiums declining from peak but still elevated at 3-8x as underwriters cautiously monitor. Updated 2026-07-05
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 保费回落：从实战状态（6月26-28日）转向外交轨道。美伊多哈会谈（7月2-3日）达成继续磋商共识。7月3日联合声明。阿曼提出海峡通行费方案（纽约时报，7月3日）。联合国警告逐步开放'非权宜之计'（7月1日）。哈梅内伊葬礼（7月4-6日）使谈判暂缓。战争险保费从峰值回落但仍偏高。更新于 2026-07-05

straitThroughput.value_zh: 约1-2桶/天 | 谈判中部分开放
straitThroughput.note: CESSATION OF HOSTILITIES: US-Iran Doha talks (Jul 2-3) focused on Strait of Hormuz re-opening. UK issued joint statement Jul 3. Oman proposes fee plan (NYT, Jul 2) — ships pay transit fee to avoid being targeted. UN warns gradual re-opening 'no quick fix for developing nations' (Jul 1). Iran's envoy to China says Beijing to get Hormuz concessions (Boston Herald, Jul 5). Throughput minimal but diplomatic framework for phased re-opening emerging. Khamenei funeral (Jul 4-6) paused talks; revenge rhetoric may complicate. Updated 2026-07-05
straitThroughput.note_zh: 敌对行动暂停：美伊多哈会谈（7月2-3日）聚焦海峡重开。英国7月3日联合声明。阿曼提出通行费方案——船只支付通行费以免遭攻击。联合国警告逐步开放非权宜之计（7月1日）。伊朗驻华大使称北京将获海峡权益（7月5日）——此为关键发展。通过量极小但外交框架初现。哈梅内伊葬礼暂缓谈判。更新于 2026-07-05

irgcStatementFreq.note: IRGC statement frequency declined from crisis peak as combat operations ceased. Khamenei funeral (Jul 4-6) dominates Iranian news cycle. Iran's top negotiator warned France and UK over potential joint patrols during funeral ceremony (PBS/AP, Jul 4). Revenge rhetoric still elevated but structured around funeral/negotiations rather than active strikes. Mojtaba Khamenei confirmed as new Supreme Leader. Updated 2026-07-05
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: IRGC声明频率从危机峰值回落，实战行动已停止。哈梅内伊葬礼主导伊朗新闻周期。伊朗首席谈判代表在葬礼期间警告法英勿联合巡逻（PBS，7月4日）。复仇言论仍高但围绕葬礼和谈判。穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊确认为新最高领袖。更新于 2026-07-05

fleetPosition.value: Supporting diplomacy — Doha talks underway, strike posture relaxed
fleetPosition.value_zh: 支持外交——多哈谈判中，打击姿态放松
fleetPosition.note: PHASE SHIFT: US 5th fleet transitioned from active combat strikes (Jun 26-28) to supporting diplomatic track. Doha talks (Jul 2-3) between US and Iran produced agreement to continue discussions on Hormuz re-opening. UK joint statement Jul 3. Oman proposed fee plan for Strait transit. CENTCOM posture remains watchful but strike operations paused alongside diplomatic engagement. Khamenei funeral (Jul 4-6) creates temporary pause. Updated 2026-07-05
fleetPosition.note_zh: 阶段转变：美第5舰队从实战打击（6月26-28日）转为支持外交轨道。美伊多哈会谈（7月2-3日）达成继续磋商海峡重开共识。英国7月3日联合声明。阿曼提出通行费方案。CENTCOM保持警惕但打击行动暂停。哈梅内伊葬礼造成临时停顿。更新于 2026-07-05

saudiUaeStance.value: Saudi backing diplomatic solution, GCC unified behind Oman fee plan
saudiUaeStance.value_zh: 沙特支持外交解决，GCC团结于阿曼通行费方案
saudiUaeStance.threshold_zh: 自行其是 = 同盟裂痕
saudiUaeStance.note: Saudi backing Doha diplomatic track. Oman's proposed fee plan for Strait transit gaining GCC traction (CNBC, Jul 4). Hajj 2026 security managed — funeral does not directly threaten Hajj. Iran's negotiator warned France/UK over joint patrols — escalating intra-GCC tension. Iran envoy to China says Beijing to get Hormuz concessions — potential wedge between GCC and China. MBS has not left Saudi since recent events. OPEC+ production policy adjusting to Hormuz disruption. Updated 2026-07-05
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: 沙特支持多哈外交轨道。阿曼海峡通行费方案获GCC支持（CNBC，7月4日）。朝觐安全可控。伊朗谈判代表警告法英勿联合巡逻——加剧GCC内部隐忧。伊朗驻华大使称北京将获海峡权益——或成GCC与中国之间楔子。MBS近期未出访。OPEC+产量政策正适应霍尔木兹中断。更新于 2026-07-05
